title: Same-Sign Correlation Bound Without Independence
summary: Independence guarantees the correlation bound; it remains open whether the same lower bound holds for same-sign correlations without independence.

formal_statement.body: Without independence, prove or refute that same-sign $\varepsilon_1,\varepsilon_2$ imply $|\varepsilon|\geq\max\{|\varepsilon_1|,|\varepsilon_2|\}$.

scope.domain: Conditional-correlation bounds in correlation cube cryptanalysis.
assumptions: The component correlations $\varepsilon_1$ and $\varepsilon_2$ have the same sign.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or refute that the combined-correlation lower bound holds for same-sign component correlations without statistical independence.

citations.label: Correlation Cube Attacks: From Weak-Key Distinguisher to Key Recovery

progress.summary: Experiments on Trivium support independence as a reasonable approximation, although the authors do not expect it to hold perfectly. They conjecture that the bound remains sound for same-sign correlations even when independence fails.
citation_labels: Meicheng Liu et al., Correlation Cube Attacks: From Weak-Key Distinguisher to Key Recovery
